name: 2394-longdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- a weights-only mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies. bf16, 15 GB.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head dim 128, max_position_embeddings 131072.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 40 requests with a 1800 s safety cap and a 10% warmup pinned to `mode: requests` -- 36 requests measured, about 12 minutes.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 2048 prompt tokens in, 2048 tokens out, fixed, `ignore_eos: true`, temperature 0.0. Every request is one prefill forward then exactly 2048 decode steps over a KV context sweeping 2048 -> 4096 tokens.
purpose: A single-user report drafting service turning 2048-token briefs into 2048-token drafts on an eight-billion-parameter model and one GPU.
launch:
# sglang 0.4.0.post1-era ServerArgs: every key here is a real field at the pinned commit.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader and never reaches the
# engine, which then starts at rc=0 without the argument, so check every value is on one line.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The default backend at this release is flashinfer, and flashinfer is installed in this venv:
# dropping this line runs a different attention backend.
attention-backend: triton

disable-radix-cache: true
context-length: 8192
max-total-tokens: 65536
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
